name: Blake Sulivan
blurb: My name is Blake Sullivan, and I serve as the Project Coordinator for Youth Employment Program, Inc. (YEP). I am a graduate of the University of Montana Western, where I earned a Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Sustainability.  I am passionate about connecting young people with meaningful employment opportunities that foster personal growth, professional development, and a strong work ethic. Through collaboration with agency partners, conservation organizations, and local communities, I strive to create hands-on experiences that help youth build valuable life skills while making a positive impact on the landscapes and communities they serve.  My work is driven by a commitment to conservation, responsible land stewardship, and the belief that investing in young people today helps build stronger communities and a healthier environment for the future.
